I've been frequenting Wash Dog Roma Prati for some time now, and I can say with absolute certainty that it has become the true go-to place for my furry friends. In a neighborhood like Prati, finding such a dedicated and well-kept space is by no means a given.
​The Atmosphere: Welcoming and Impeccable
As soon as you walk in, you immediately sense a calm and clean atmosphere. Despite the high influx of dogs, the place is always perfectly sanitized and free of unpleasant odors, which immediately conveys a sense of security and comfort to both owner and pet.
​The Groomer: A True Artist
A special mention absolutely goes to the groomer: I consider him a true artist of the trade. His mastery of cutting and finishing is astonishing, but what is most striking is the aesthetic sensitivity and surgical precision with which he works. Each dog leaves transformed, with a look that is meticulously cared for down to the smallest details, enhancing the natural beauty of each breed. It's clear that this isn't just work, but true art applied to animal welfare.
​Ozone Therapy: Well-Being and Deep Hygiene
Another service I now consider essential is ozone therapy treatment. It's a real boon for skin and fur: not only does it deeply cleanse, but it also helps soothe any irritation and leaves their coat incredibly silky and shiny. My dogs seem regenerated after each session, much more relaxed and visibly reinvigorated.
​Why it's my go-to:
​Top-notch professionalism: Competent staff, always ready to offer the right advice.
​Product quality: They only use top-quality shampoos and treatments.
​Flexibility: The convenience of 24-hour service (for members) is priceless for those with hectic schedules.
​In conclusion, if you're looking for a place where dog care is taken to the highest levels of professionalism, love, and expertise, Wash Dog Prati is the best choice you can make. My little ones always come out happy, smelling good and pampered like nowhere else.

My story begins in April 2025, the month I got my membership card at the toilet on Via di Donna Olimpia.
When I inquired about getting a membership card, I wasn't told I'd have to pay €60, but it seemed like the membership was free; anyway, I got the card and paid.
I used the self-service service once, and less than a month after getting the card, I was told the toilet would close in two or three days. At least self-service was guaranteed.
Meanwhile, this highlights the lack of seriousness and transparency, because it's impossible they didn't know they were closing soon.
I also tried to contact the toilet on Via di Donna Olimpia, and a person answered, taking my number and saying they'd have Wash Dog management contact me (which never happened).
I contacted the grooming shop on Via Luigi Rizzo, where they told me they couldn't help me and that the only solution was to go there to avoid losing the money on my card. This was because, ignoring the fact that if someone uses a specific location, it's because they live there, it's convenient, and they can't move their dog.
As of today, the self-service service has also been removed from the Donna Olimpia branch.
That said, I tried contacting the administration directly, without success.
HIGHLY NOT RECOMMENDED.
A thousand thanks!!!

Today was my first experience at Wash Dog in Rome Prati because, unfortunately, the one in my area has been permanently closed. I couldn't have had a better experience! A clean environment equipped with every comfort and service to best wash your dog in safety, serenity, and wholesome fun. But what made it all truly exceptional was the kindness, professionalism, and friendliness of the groomer there (whose name, unfortunately, escapes me). He explained to us how to best perform each procedure, helped us choose the best membership, was with us until the end of his shift, and truly made us feel at home! The world needs people like this, to remind us of the beauty of Harmony and Humanity, which unfortunately cannot be taken for granted these days. I will definitely return for the self-service, to experience the professional grooming service, and, above all, to learn the name of the man who made this moment truly enjoyable and to whom I owe my gratitude.
The only flaws (if we really had to nitpick!): difficulty finding parking and only two self-service stalls.
It's our first time there, we had a great time, and we got a season ticket. The receptionist was very kind and helpful in explaining everything in detail.
A thousand thanks!
